description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Dark with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Dark Mode I (Shadow)], [Dark Resonance +5% Boost] and [Physical Blink Stacking 2] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Dark Mode I (Shadow)
description.text: Dark abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Dark abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Dark abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Dark Mode II (Shadow)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Dark Mode II (Shadow)
description.text: Dark abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Dark abilities, grants [200% ATB 2], [Dark Ability Instant Cast 2] and [Physical Blink 2] after using Dark abilities

description.name: 200% ATB 2
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x2.00

description.name: Dark Ability Instant Cast 2
description.text: Instant cast speed for Dark abilities

description.name: Physical Blink 2
description.text: Evades the next 2 PHY attacks that deal physical, missing HP or fixed damage or NAT attacks that deal physical or fractional damage

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Physical Blink Stacking 2
description.text: Allows to stack Physical Blink, up to Physical Blink 2
